fact: A July 2026 Maliweb review of land reforms says NINACAD unique cadastral numbers had been assigned to over 1.5 million parcels in Bamako's six communes, Kati, Ségou, Koulikoro, Sikasso and three communes, and that the digitised document module MoDoNum was updated at the Bamako and Kati land registries.
title: Gestion foncière et domaniale : le bilan des réformes phares de la Transition
